task.title: Give each signed-in person a budget on a hosted board
task.description:
One signed-in person can grow a hosted board's disk, the remote, and every teammate's clone without limit, and can take more than their share of the server. Shared history is append-only, so removing an attachment frees nothing: on 2026-11-21, 25 rounds of adding and removing a 1 MiB file grew the repository by 26.5 MB with nothing left attached, and there is no ceiling on the number of tasks. Found by "Review the board for use by several people at once".

0.6.3 adds a server-wide cap on work in flight ("Cap how much work the board does at once") and relies on limits set at the sign-in proxy. That is enough for a team that admits only people it trusts not to vandalize. This task is what a board needs before it admits people the team does not trust that far.

## What is needed

- A cap on requests one person has in flight, keyed by the name the sign-in proxy supplies, with the excess refused rather than queued behind everyone else.
- A budget of bytes written per person per window (attachments and text), with a clear refusal that names the window.
- A decision on whether there is also a server-wide ceiling on tasks or stored bytes. Removal never frees space in append-only history; recovery is deleting the tasks and `workbook compact --deleted-only`.
- Defaults documented in the hosting guide.

Not decided: window sizes, defaults, and what happens at each limit.
